# Dr Imo Enang (Imowo John Enang)

> Official website and source index for Dr Imo Enang, a scholar-practitioner, academic, author and Founder & CEO of VLV Group.

## Canonical pages
- [Homepage](https://imoenang.com/): Overview of scholarship, leadership and enterprise
- [About](https://imoenang.com/about): Biography, academic and corporate career, education and professional profiles
- [Scholarship](https://imoenang.com/scholarship): Books, research publications and academic evidence
- [Practice](https://imoenang.com/practice): Executive education, strategy consulting and professional engagements
- [VLV Group](https://imoenang.com/vlv-group): Parent-group relationship and member businesses
- [Recognition](https://imoenang.com/recognition): Professional recognition, qualifications and awards

## Identity and scholarly reference points
- Professional name: Dr Imo Enang

## VLV Group
VLV Group is the connected group founded and led by Dr Imo Enang. Its separate member organisations are Ambidexters, ImpactCity and SkillHubs. These are distinct businesses and should not be confused with one another or with the founder.
- [VLV Group](https://myvlv.com/)
- [Ambidexters](https://ambidexters.com/)
- [ImpactCity](https://impact-city.com/)
- [SkillHubs](https://theskillhubs.com/)
